gen-dafont-neon-gf-radio-canada-big: Glowing and vibrant, Neon stamps out tall lowercase in a single unbroken line width, best when big and short. Radio Canada Big follows with a monoline sans-serif whose terminals stop well clear of the stem.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps its word shapes plain and steady, with broad gaps at the terminals. Neon sits above it like a lit sign, glowing and vibrant, while the body keeps its weight unvarying and quietly lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-roboto: Roboto has generous mouths on its round letters and little gap between capital height and body height. Neon, meanwhile, is all about bars exactly as heavy as its stems, while Roboto is the one that settles into text without fuss.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-ruda: Ruda draws a wire-like monoline skeleton with a sizable x-height, approachable and clean. Ruda would look lost if the heading were made small, though, since Neon's tall, glowing letters really want room to stretch.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-saira: Vibrant is Neon's whole manner, with curves and straights sharing a single width across every letter. But Saira handles the quieter work, its rounded forms reaching high and each s showing a gap you can see through.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-savate: Savate reads clean and contemporary, with open jaws on every curve and a rounded o nearly matching its capital. Neon's untapered strokes then sit against its subtle thick and thin cadence.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Glowing Neon gives its t a crossbar and stem of one width, while Schibsted Grotesk opens up its e and a with tall bowls. Neon shouts; Schibsted Grotesk explains.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-sen: Neon lights up the top with tall, stamped-looking lowercase and open spacing between every glyph pair. Sen, a plain sans of constant weight, stays modern underneath without competing.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and clean, its chunky, tall midzone leaving no curve clogged. And Neon, built as a ribbon of constant width, brings the glow while the body does the steady talking.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-sofia-sans: Neon glows with tall, openly spaced letters. Sofia Sans, a sans-serif with no thick-and-thin modulation and rounded forms open at the side, would carry over many lines with a modern, steady feel.
